content.title: Why Packaging Corporation of America (PKG) Shares Are Trading Lower Today
content.summary: Shares of packaging Corporation of America (NYSE:PKG) fell 5.4% in the afternoon session after a report from Bloomberg Intelligence indicated that demand for boxes was expected to weaken. The report, which surveyed managers, noted that box demand was forecasted to rise only 1.3% in December compared to the previous year.
